python3 -B - <<'PY'
import json,http.client,pathlib,subprocess,sys
sha="79aa27f8bd257d8ee9a84b46a5ee996f3f2e026b"
def check(label,ok):
 print(label+"="+("PASS" if ok else "FAIL"),flush=True)
 if not ok:sys.exit(42)
token=(pathlib.Path.home()/".config"/"tgtumbler"/"tumblr-operation-app"/"tumblr-app-access-token").read_text().strip()
def get(path):
 c=http.client.HTTPConnection("127.0.0.1",8081,timeout=8)
 try:
  c.request("GET",path,headers={"Authorization":"Bearer "+token})
  r=c.getresponse();return r.status,r.read(200000)
 finally:c.close()
actual=subprocess.run(["git","rev-parse","HEAD"],capture_output=True,text=True,check=True,timeout=8).stdout.strip()
check("REPO_SHA",actual==sha)
status,body=get("/healthz")
check("LIVE_SHA",status==200 and json.loads(body).get("commit")==sha)
status,js=get("/app.js")
check("UI_SAVED_PAGE_NAVIGATION",status==200 and b'stored_next_target' in js and b'stored_prev_target' in js)
for suite in ("test_discovery_engine.py","test_operation_app.py","test_assistant.py","test_library.py"):
 p=subprocess.run([sys.executable,"-B","-m","unittest","discover","-s","tests","-p",suite,"-q"],
     stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL,stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL,timeout=45)
 check("OFFLINE_"+suite,p.returncode==0)
print("PROVIDER_CALLS=ZERO")
print("ACCEPTANCE=PASS")
PY
